newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Qantas committed to Air NZ stake.
newsitem.headline: Qantas committed to Air NZ stake.

text.p: Qantas Airways Ltd reaffirmed on Monday its commitment to retaining its 19.4 percent stake in rival airline Air New Zealand.

"I think company representatives are on record as indicating that that situation sits, that we are not in the business of doing anything which is going to impact adversely on that investment," government and international relations general manager David Hawes told an aviation conference.
"But we are a commercial competitor so we have the interests of Qantas shareholders also to look at and I think that is well understood in the market place."
Hawes also said competition with Air NZ was likely to continue to rise.

"That's an investment which is really important to us, but at the end of the day we are commercial competitors of Air New Zealand in the market place and I think the indications of recent times is that that competition is bound to intensify."
